rationale: RESUBMISSION of corr 62d2463f-b269-41fb-8f25-078983ffceab (REVISE, gated by debug_historian HIGH). Every objection is answered by a shipped change, a verbatim quote of code the objection could not see, or an owner ruling - not reassurance. (1) debug_historian HIGH, 'UPDATE scoped by type with no visible is_active qualifier' + the dual-active-row landmine: the seed's UPDATE was always qualified - WHERE type='build-site-planner' AND is_active AND COALESCE(is_snapshot,false)=false AND deleted_at IS NULL (the sketch now quotes it) - and the seed now ALSO carries the apply-time exactly-one-active-row refusal guard, the identical guard the council APPROVED yesterday-today on corr d1e8c36e for seeds 386/387/388: a DO/RAISE that refuses unless build-site-planner has exactly one active non-snapshot row, so 'UPDATE 1 + verify passed' cannot describe a row the loader never reads. (2) guardian, 'needs a check before apply, not before submission': that guard IS the check-before-apply. (3) guardian low, dump-to-apply concurrency: the anchors are evaluated against the LIVE row inside the seed's own transaction - the dump only DERIVED the anchor strings. A concurrent template change flips the anchor count (guard RAISEs) or the exact post-length 20,445 (verify RAISEs and the transaction aborts); a concurrent change elsewhere in default_config is untouched by the single-path jsonb_set and serialises on the row lock. (4) bug_historian, 'visibility without enforcement': the scope is the owner's, ruled 2026-08-10 and scheduled 2026-08-11 - detection first (RECOMPOSE_INTENT_NOT_REALISED, live v1.0.1283, durable), field visibility now (this round), the prose-escape retirement as the registered follow-up after a live recompose run proves the field. Hard enforcement at validate is not available in principle: validate cannot COMPOSE a redesign - only the planner LLM composes - so the honest enforcement point is the durable intent-not-realised record, which is exactly the loud-signal shape the council itself recommended on this feature in its 2026-07-24 round (features_open/012 open item 4, since merged into the detection). (5) guidelines, register naming per the 2026-08-11 nested-contract ruling: CORRECT CATCH, and the ruling being applied is the one this lane seated this afternoon - the resubmission commit now ships PBP-041, a dedicated concept-register entry for the needs_site_plan.spec.recompose_pages seam naming BOTH readers (validate pre-filter; plan_site template marker) plus the index row. (6) debug_historian, which snapshot_agent overload: the two-argument form, which writes agent_definitions_backup keyed by snapshot_taken_at - verified WORKING this same afternoon on the d1e8c36e applies, where both snapshots landed there and were proven true PRE-update copies (backup rows do not contain the change). (7) debug_historian low, rollback discipline: 385_..._ROLLBACK.sql now ships alongside (restore from bak_385, verify the marker absent and length back to exactly 19,685). (8) bug_historian low, the unconditional paragraph: the render proof explicitly covered the zero-flagged case - full template rendered with no spec, spec without the key, empty list, and no input_data at all: zero markers, no '<no value>'; the paragraph is static prose whose closing sentence ('pages NOT flagged keep the preserve-exactly rule') is true and reinforcing when nothing is flagged. Original rationale for the round stands (the 362 prose-escape no-op, LANDMINES 2026-08-10, owner rulings) and is not repeated.
